methodology.timing: collect() warmups then timed samples per scenario; samplesMs is the raw evidence
methodology.scope: Each scenario owns its setup, validates its own result, and reports non-time counters beside the timing so a wrong-but-fast path cannot pass the run.

scenarios.unit: one addRows projection of 10,000 rows into a 1,000,000-row bridge
scenarios.validation: projected delta is one row-structure insert with every created identity present in the bridge in order

scenarios.unit: one 4,096-cell range selection on a framework-style grid
scenarios.validation: selection covers 4096 cells and the command-state handler observes one event per selection
every setBlock is applied and every cell of the block holds the last written value

scenarios.unit: one Grid.applyTransaction of a 1,000,000-cell setBlock observed through a change listener with detailed capture
scenarios.validation: every setBlock is applied and every cell of the block holds the last written value, and its change capture reports every cell's address, previous value, and new value exactly once

scenarios.unit: one grid commit admitted into an offline sync queue with no listeners
scenarios.validation: every commit is applied, the queue holds every commit at server version 0, and capacity stays available

scenarios.unit: one rebase of a 100,000-cell block across 50 single-row inserts
scenarios.validation: the block rebases without conflict, shifts down by exactly the inserted row count, keeps every source value, and leaves the caller's operations untouched

scenarios.unit: one 100,000-cell sparse setRange with 100 rules outside the range
scenarios.validation: every write is applied, probe cells hold the last written values, every rule is retained, and a rule violation is still rejected

scenarios.unit: one fromCsv import of 200,000 rows by 10 columns
scenarios.validation: row count matches and every imported cell equals the source value for its row and column, including declared number/text types
the clear empties the block and the undos restore every original cell value
a valid near-ceiling compressed restore applies its complete block

scenarios.unit: one revisit of an evicted paged band: scroll back plus a fixed async settle floor (wall time is not the accept metric)
scenarios.validation: the band is unloaded before each revisit, the revisit reloads it with the source values, and the revisit asks areColumnsFullyLoaded at least once; areColumnsFullyLoadedCalls per revisit is the accept metric

scenarios.unit: one cold initSheetwrite() through first store in a fresh Node process (7 processes)
scenarios.validation: every fresh process loads the module, produces the expected engine result, and reports a plausible heartbeat gap
